Nel mezzo della bellissima Emmental – la vostra nuova sfida vi aspetta! Con specialisti nelle due sedi ospedaliere di Burgdorf e Langnau, l'Ospedale Emmental garantisce assistenza medica di alta qualità a 150.000 residenti – 24 ore su 24. Cura con cuore e responsabilità: diventa parte del nostro team! Cosa ci rende speciali? In quanto ospedale periferico versatile con cuore e mente, viviamo un'atmosfera di fiducia e un'atmosfera lavorativa caratterizzata da apertura, rispetto e apprezzamento. Per noi lavorare in modo moderno significa agire umanamente, con libertà creativa e ascolto reciproco. I nostri dipendenti sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo invece di essere semplicemente presenti, sia a livello professionale che personale. Condizioni favorevoli alla famiglia e una pianificazione dei turni concordata fanno per noi parte della vita quotidiana. Per il nostro reparto medico presso la sede di Burgdorf, che dispone di 33 posti letto e conta circa 50 dipendenti, studenti e apprendisti, cerchiamo un posto nel mezzo della bellissima Emmental dal 1° luglio 2026 o previo accordo: la vostra nuova sfida vi aspetta! • Sarai responsabile di un gruppo infermieristico e lavorerai a stretto contatto con professionisti sanitari, assistenti infermieristici, studenti e apprendisti

• Trovi entusiasmante e arricchente l'ampio spettro medico di un ospedale periferico familiare
• Tratti le persone con rispetto e apprezzamento, perché la migliore assistenza possibile per i nostri pazienti è la tua massima priorità

descriptionByLocale.en:
In the middle of the beautiful Emmental – your new challenge is waiting for you! With specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, the Emmental Hospital ensures high-quality medical care for 150,000 residents – around the clock. Care with heart and responsibility – become part of our team! What makes us special? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live a trusting atmosphere and a working atmosphere that is characterized by openness, respect and appreciation. For us, working in a modern way means: acting humanely, with creative freedom and an open ear for one another. Our employees are right in the middle of everything we do instead of just being there – both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and jointly designed duty scheduling are part of everyday life for us. For our medical department at the Burgdorf location, which has 33 beds and includes around 50 employees as well as students and apprentices, we are looking for a place in the middle of the beautiful Emmental as of July 1, 2026 or by arrangement - your new challenge is waiting for you! • You will be in charge of a nursing group and work closely with health professionals, nursing assistants, students and apprentices
• You control the entire nursing process - supported by our clinical information system Clinical - and ensure complete documentation
• Together as a team, you continuously optimize the nursing processes and contribute your ideas
• As a mentor, you accompany and support students and learners on their path to the nursing profession This is what you need to be successful
• You are qualified. Nursing specialist (HF/FH) or close to graduation and ideally have already gained experience in acute care
• You find the wide medical spectrum of a family peripheral hospital exciting and enriching
• You treat people with respect and appreciation, because the best possible care for our patients is your top priority
• You work carefully, conscientiously and like to take on responsibility
• Further development is a matter of course for you and you want to constantly expand your skills
• You have a confident command of the German language (B2 certificate for foreign-language applicants is the minimum requirement) Our offer Holidays GAV Culinary Modern Human In the Middle Parking Occasions Discounts

Das Spital Emmental sorgt mit Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten an den beiden Spitalstandorten Burgdorf und Langnau für die hochstehende medizinische Versorgung von 150 000 Einwohnerinnen und Einwohnern – rund um die Uhr. Pflege mit Herz und Verantwortung – werde Teil unseres Teams! Was uns besonders macht? Als vielseitiges Peripheriespital mit Herz und Verstand leben wir ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander und ein Arbeitsklima, das von Offenheit, Respekt und Wertschätzung geprägt ist. Modern arbeiten heisst für uns: menschlich handeln, mit Gestaltungsfreiraum und einem offenen Ohr füreinander. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind bei uns mittendrin statt nur dabei – fachlich wie persönlich. Familienfreundliche Bedingungen und eine gemeinsam gestaltete Dienstplanung gehören bei uns zum gelebten Alltag. • Du begegnest Menschen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung, denn die bestmögliche Betreuung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten steht für dich an erster Stelle
